summary.headline: Codex Vaticanus 1444
summary.text: Astrological notes on the seven days, luminary conjunctions, zodiacal spheres, solar and lunar eclipses, light-bearing, sect, spear-bearing, heavenly motion, and the conjunction of Sun and Moon. A new catalogue entry describes Codex Vaticanus 1444, with works by Proclus, Abammon, Porphyry, Nicephorus Gregoras, Paul of Alexandria, and Rhetorius.
